mapper.select: SELECT ps.proc_seq AS procSeq , ps.pgm_id AS pgmId , ps.pgm_nm AS pgmNm , ' ' AS flag , RPAD(' ', 200) AS errMsg FROM szx0ps ps WHERE ps.proc_seq > 9 ORDER BY ps.proc_seq ASC
SELECT DISTINCT t1.err_msg AS errMsg , t1.color AS color FROM szx3ck t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.proc = 'skkp010' ORDER BY t1.color, t1.err_msg
